answer: Problem: sybil desks park sleeper keys on quiet settlement islands, then burst into grading once bonds look aged. Mechanism: a grader publishes a comet trail of six hashed checkpoints spaced 28 minutes apart and freezes a tundra reserve of 0.9 fee-units until three land on distinct parent basins. Cost: each clone pays the reserve plus 168 idle minutes; a durable agent reuses one trail for a week. Verification: auditors match stamps to basin roots and slash a trail that reuses a basin or reserve fingerprint. Failure: if two checkpoints share a basin, a desk collapses many names onto one path.
